decision.rule: Treat BT.709-tagged SDR video as equivalent to sRGB: no transfer conversion on the way in or out.

rootCause.renderer: Exact: the canvas holds authored sRGB bytes.
rootCause.export: composition-output-1 re-encoded every --format profile's sRGB bytes with the BT.709 camera OETF (sRGB -> linear -> 1.099 L^0.45 - 0.099): #2F6F6A (47,111,106) -> (31,97,92), #111111 -> 6. The default MP4 path did not, under the same BT.709 tags.
rootCause.decode: composition-media-decoder-2 mapped BT.709-transfer video and sequences through the inverse OETF into sRGB, lifting dark and mid tones: code 16 -> 31, 64 -> 79, 128 -> 140 (largest lift +16 near code 18). --format outputs undid it; the default MP4 did not, so footage came out lighter than its source, and the canvas, pixel lint and legibility measured footage lighter than players show it.

fix.export: composition-output-2: every path writes the renderer's sRGB bytes unchanged (16-bit profiles expand bytes x 257). Video profiles (prores4444, h264, hevc10, prores422hq, vp9alpha) keep BT.709 primaries/transfer/matrix tags, which players show like sRGB. PNG profiles (png8, png16) are tagged sRGB: FFmpeg writes the PNG sRGB chunk (with compatibility gAMA/cHRM) instead of cICP; the output validator now requires that chunk for sRGB profiles and BT.709 cICP only for a BT.709 PNG profile (none remain). Profiles carry a `transfer` field; result metrics record it.
fix.decode: composition-media-decoder-3: range and matrix convert to full RGB; no transfer conversion for BT.709 or sRGB SDR sources. Sequences of either transfer decode through the same filter (exact 16-to-8-bit rounding, separate alpha); decoder 2 used a bare `format=rgba` for sRGB sequences, which rounded some 16-bit samples up by one (found when PNG16 deliveries, now sRGB-tagged, were reimported).

otherSourceTags.srgbTransferVideo: Already decoded without transfer conversion on main; unchanged. Under the rule the SDR transfer tag (bt709 or iec61966-2-1) no longer changes samples, only range and matrix do.
otherSourceTags.smpte170mMatrix: Not accepted by the media contract (unchanged here). The owner's Google Flow clips (bt709 primaries, sRGB transfer, smpte170m matrix, tv range) would, once accepted, decode with the BT.601 (smpte170m) matrix and limited-to-full range, with no transfer conversion. Update 2026-11-17: `main` d9ad624e (CGA, PR #70) accepts smpte170m; after merging it into this branch they decode exactly that way.
otherSourceTags.pngSequences: BT.709-cICP and sRGB sequences both use their samples unchanged; the descriptor transfer must still match the PNG's colour authority, as before.
